name: Runeshield Brotten
bio: Never a hair out of place. Never a dent on his shield. Never a second late. In his mind, Brotten is the model guard. Such is his devotion, he's been known to stop mid-brawl to clean any muck besmirching the King's face on his shield. All the while, keeping miscreants at bay. Talk about loving your job.
